The directories are recursively traversed for Python sources. Here is a sample Python 2.x source file, example.py: def greet(name): print \"Hello, {0}!\".format(name) print \"What's your name?\" name = raw_input() greet(name) It can be converted to Python 3.x code via 2to3 on the command line: $ 2to3 example.py A diff against the original source file is printed. 2to3 can also write the needed modifications right back to the source file.
